decidedBy: Essenthos, 2026-10-08, on the family relationships that contradicted themselves: each read against the Hebrew of its verse by gpt-6.1-sol (Codex, reasoning high) and checked by claude-opus-5-5, under the project owner's decision of 2026-09-16 that a namesake the text does not identify is a person of his own and that where the text leaves an identification open the record says so
policy: A record is one man, and a word names the one its verse names. Where one record held a man whose father the verse names otherwise, his occurrence goes to a record of his own.
source: Essenthos, on the family relationships that contradicted themselves, each read against its verse by gpt-6.1-sol (Codex) and claude-opus-5-5, 2026-10-08

create.name: Jeshua
create.distinguisher: son of Kadmiel, one of the chiefs of the Levites in the days of Joiakim (NEH 12:24)
create.notes: Whether he is Jeshua the son of Azaniah of NEH 10:9 the text does not say.

rulings.why: 'And the chief of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel' (וְיֵשׁוּעַ בֶּן־קַדְמִיאֵל); the Levite Jeshua who sealed the covenant is the son of Azaniah (NEH 10:9), and the text does not make the two one.
